item.title: Send your check-in photo in the group text
item.summary: In a game's iMessage chat, a photo you send with "done", or right after Murph asks for it, now posts as that day's check-in without a follow-up question.
item.details: If Murph posts the wrong photo, tell it which one to use and it swaps the picture on that same post, so you keep your retake in the app. Replacing a post you made in the app still uses your retake, and Murph asks first.
